reasons.plausibility: Adding Nb to enhance grain-boundary precipitation and ductility in refractory HEAs is scientifically credible, although fine details of phase stability remain to be fully confirmed.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison of Nb-doped vs. undoped alloys under controlled processing and mechanical testing provides a clear experimental path to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis outlines a concrete approach to enhance ductility while retaining key properties in refractory HEAs, offering a direct path for practical materials optimization.
